task.title: Use the Library
task.shortdesc: Open the Library and use its counts, status, and row actions as the starting point for saved profile work.

prereq.p: BPM is open and you are working with saved profile records, not an unsaved editor draft.

context.p: The Library lists saved profiles and shows filtered and total counts so you know whether filters or search are hiding rows. Its action grid comes first; the filter row is immediately above the profile table. An active saved ESR 115.39 or ESR 140.13 profile can offer a review update to the latest ESR, ESR 153.0. Opening that recommendation only opens a preview and does not change the profile; Release 153, ESR 153.0, unknown, retired, inactive, and unsaved profiles receive no invented recommendation.

image.alt: Library showing saved profile rows, counts, and profile actions.

info.p: Expected result: the Library loads profile rows, or an empty-state message if no saved profiles exist.

step.cmd: Use the action grid to refresh the list, start a new draft, open Compare, or import policies.json.

info.p: These actions appear before the filters and table.

step.cmd: Set search, schema, profile-state, validation, and sort filters directly above the table; then read the filtered and total counts before using a row action.

info.note: A row action applies to that saved profile, not to a temporary editor draft. A recommended ESR update is not an automatic change: review its preview and explicitly confirm an applicable result.

result.p: You can identify the active Library view and choose the next profile action without losing context.

postreq.p: Recovery: if rows do not load or an action status remains failed, refresh the Library and then use the Library troubleshooting topic.
